# alvo:    inputChainRules_politica_drop
# cenário: hairpin_sem_mtu
# sobre:   a mesma VM de uma placa, com uplink e rede local conhecidos, mas SEM MTU de
#          caminho (pathMTU = 0): uma nuvem que o produto ainda não sabe medir. O
#          masquerade qualificado sai assim mesmo; a mss_clamp nasce VAZIA em vez de
#          inventar número.
# entrada: groups = 1 grupo(s) de escopo input, ntpNetworks = ["10.0.0.0/24"], ntpServing =
#          true, policy = "drop", access = {ssh [22], painel 9997, lan ["10.0.0.0/24"], wan
#          por dhcp true}, wanIfaces = ["ens3"], gerenciaFechada = false, contencao = false,
#          wireGuardPorts = [51820]
# formato: `argv` é o CONTRATO (um token por argumento, entre aspas);
#          `nft ` é a mesma regra como o nft a lê.
#
# GERADO POR zonas_golden_test.go. Um diff aqui é uma mudança no que o
# firewall manda ao kernel — nunca edite este arquivo para fazer um teste passar.

 1. argv  "ct" "state" "related" "counter" "accept"
    nft   ct state related counter accept
 2. argv  "iif" "lo" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iif lo counter accept
 3. argv  "icmpv6" "type" "{ nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   icmpv6 type { nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert } counter accept
 4. argv  "tcp" "dport" "{ 22, 9997 }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   tcp dport { 22, 9997 } counter accept
 5. argv  "udp" "dport" "67" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   udp dport 67 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
 6. argv  "udp" "dport" "53" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   udp dport 53 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
 7. argv  "tcp" "dport" "53" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   tcp dport 53 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
 8. argv  "udp" "dport" "68" "counter" "accept"
    nft   udp dport 68 counter accept
 9. argv  "udp" "dport" "123" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   udp dport 123 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
10. argv  "udp" "dport" "123" "counter" "drop"
    nft   udp dport 123 counter drop
11. argv  "ip" "saddr" "192.168.3.0/24" "counter" "jump" "grp_6f1c2d3e4a5b"
    nft   ip saddr 192.168.3.0/24 counter jump grp_6f1c2d3e4a5b
12. argv  "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "{ nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type { nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert } counter accept
13. argv  "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "{ packet-too-big, time-exceeded, parameter-problem, destination-unreachable }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type { packet-too-big, time-exceeded, parameter-problem, destination-unreachable } counter accept
14. argv  "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "udp" "dport" "68" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } udp dport 68 counter accept
15. argv  "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "udp" "dport" "546" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname { "ens3" } udp dport 546 counter accept
16. argv  "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "ct" "status" "dnat" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } ct status dnat counter accept
17. argv  "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "icmp" "type" "echo-request" "limit" "rate" "5/second" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } icmp type echo-request limit rate 5/second counter accept
18. argv  "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "echo-request" "limit" "rate" "5/second" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type echo-request limit rate 5/second counter accept
19. argv  "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "tcp" "dport" "{ 22, 9997 }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } tcp dport { 22, 9997 } counter accept
20. argv  "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "udp" "dport" "51820" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } udp dport 51820 counter accept
21. argv  "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "ct" "state" "new" "counter" "drop"
    nft   iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } ct state new counter drop
